environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Express application deployed on ECS Fargate with task role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/FileServiceTaskRole. The task role has an attached IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/PlatformBoundary) that denies iam:*, sts:AssumeRole, and s3:GetObject on non-application prefixes. The ECS task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with explicit tmpfs mounts for /tmp/uploads (size 64MB, noexec,nosuid) and /tmp/archive (size 64MB, noexec,nosuid). The Fargate platform version 1.4.0 applies a default seccomp profile that blocks the symlink(2), symlinkat(2), and link(2) syscalls via a custom ECS task-level seccompProfile of type RuntimeDefault with additional denied syscalls [symlink, symlinkat, link, linkat]. The VPC security group only allows inbound on port 3000 from the internal ALB.
